text:
sam: Hey team — I'm currently primary for tonight but my flight just got delayed and I won't be reachable for a ~6h window starting ~00:30 UTC. There's an active page for INC-2026 (95th pct tail latency on /generate in us-west-2). Can someone swap primary for the 00:30-06:30 UTC block? I can do a handoff now with context / links and any open mitigation steps.

oncall-bot: Handoff checklist: please post current incident(s), outstanding runbook steps, in-progress mitigations, and confirm PD escalation policy. Use `@pagerduty-bot assign` to change primary.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert INC-2026 triggered (high latency) — assigned to sam. Alert link: https://pd.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026

maria: I can take primary for that window. I'm available to shadow for the next 15m. Quick Q — is the degradation caused by autoscaler thrash or model spike?

sam: Thanks Maria, really appreciate it. Current notes:
- Symptoms: p95 go up to ~2.4s for some long seq requests (mostly customer X workloads).
- Recent change: we rolled model v3-quant ramp to 10% this morning (canary) — may correlate.
- Active mitigations: rolling back canary paused; we've enabled KV-prefix cache for the affected route.
- Customer impact: intermittent latency spikes, no dropped requests, but several retries from a partner app.
- Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/INC-2026-runbook (important section below)

sam: Runbook snippet:
```
1) Check host CPU/GPU throttling: kubectl top nodes / pods
2) If model variant is suspect, pin route to v3-quant-stable-2026 for steady perf:
   rcli route update --route /generate --model v3-quant-stable-2026
3) If latency > 2s for >5m, escalate to infra-sre and open emergency autoscaler lock
```

lisa: I can shadow as secondary for that window. If Maria takes primary, I'll pick up pages and be ready to take over at any time. Also: Maria, please confirm you'll notify the Dedicated pool team if you decide to pin the model — there are GPU scheduling implications.

alex: Heads up — there's a 01:00 UTC batch job that temporarily reduces available capacity in us-west-2. If primary/secondary swap happens, please account for that 20m window (we had a small outage last month when two nodes drained simultaneously).

maria: Got it. I'll take primary. Steps I will do now: 1) Accept incident in PD, 2) follow runbook step 2 to pin route to v3-quant-stable-2026 if we see >2s p95 sustained for 5m, 3) keep lisa as secondary. I'll post every change here.

sam: I'm transferring PD assignment to maria now: `@pagerduty-bot assign INC-2026 maria` — after this please confirm you see the PD assignment and that notifications are configured for your on-call device.

pagerduty-bot: Command received. INC-2026 reassigned to maria. Notifications: email, push.

maria: I see it in PD and notifications are enabled. Quick question: is there a temporary workaround to reduce retries from the partner app (they're on short backoff)?

sam: Short-term workaround we applied: increased route timeout to 35s and added retry jitter on our side (keeps partners from hammering back). I also bumped prefix cache TTL to 60s for the route.

maria: Doing an initial health sweep now. Running: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-serving -o wide` and `rcli metrics tail --filter route:/generate --minutes 10`

maria: Quick update — p95 has trended down to ~1.1s after cache TTL bump + paused canary. I'll leave the pin in place for 30m until we confirm stability. If it stays good, I'll coordinate with infra for a controlled rollback test.

lisa: I can take pager escalation for 00:30-02:30 while Maria sleeps — will escalate to infra-sre if we see any host-level CPU saturation. @alex please flag the batch job timing to infra so we don't overlap maintenance windows.

alex: Copied infra-sre on this thread and flagged the 01:00 batch — they acknowledged and will stagger the job if needed.

sam: Thanks everyone. Maria — if you need me reachable for critical escalation, DM me; otherwise I'm offline after 00:10 UTC. Leaving a short runbook addendum: if p95 rises >1.8s for 10m after pin, run `rcli route rollback --route /generate --to previous` and open a quick incident bridge.

maria: Acknowledged and will take point. Leaving a short note in the runbook and tagging infra: `@infra-sre` for the batch job. I'll post an end-of-window status at 06:25 UTC. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Handoff complete: primary updated to maria, secondary lisa. Coverage window: 00:30-06:30 UTC. Incident INC-2026 status: mitigation in progress, pinned to v3-quant-stable-2026, cache TTL increased.

maria: Final note before I step into primary fully — I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for the window. If anything changes, please @mention me directly.
